# Floating UI

Vendored browser ESM builds from `@floating-ui/core@1.8.0` and
`@floating-ui/dom@1.8.0`.

Source tarballs:

- `floating-ui-core-1.8.0.tgz` (SHA-256 `c86371bdb19948a71591d36f23ec33d2b54e06503bd5c2e00a2dbbfa389622fd`)
- `floating-ui-dom-1.8.0.tgz` (SHA-256 `b9511cc8fd8898c7c67143ff8dd93a3d427108632c801a546ae72ab1df3cd6a5`)

The `.mjs` browser builds are stored with a `.js` suffix so the dashboard's
native-ESM test harness rewrites their bare import-map specifiers.
